patch_description:
Replace the current block with a proven, parameter-efficient motif that previously yielded better validation/test performance. Key changes:
- Replace fixed CZ backbone with shared-parameter CRZ couplings on every allowed grid edge (gives trainable entangling flexibility without exploding parameter count).
- Keep separate shared CRZ for center–edge couplings to let center interactions differ from outer-ring edges.
- Add ZZZ three-qubit motifs aligned with the six orthogonal winning lines and separate diagonal ZZZs; these explicitly encode winning-line correlations.
- Split CCRZ center interactions into edge–edge–center and corner–corner–center shared parameters to let center-conditioned phases differ by geometric category.
- Use symmetry-grouped RY (local rotations) and RZ post-phases to reduce unique parameters while preserving expressive capacity.

This mirrors the earlier high-performing ansatz (78 params total) and should improve accuracy and generalization compared to the current CZ-heavy variant.
